tools.name: search_operators
tools.description: Lists barbers, stylists, nail techs and estheticians on Mane who have chosen to be found through AI assistants. Returns each operator’s slug, operator_id, display name, business name, city, profession and booking page URL. Operators who have not opted in are never returned. Optional filters match pa

tools.name: get_operator
tools.description: Returns the public profile of one listed operator: display name, business name, city, profession, years of experience, bio, Instagram handle and booking page URL. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the active services of one listed operator: service_id, name, description, duration in minutes, list price, after-hours price when the operator set one, and whether it is a mobile or request-only service. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

tools.name: list_availability
tools.description: Lists the open start times for one service on one date, from the same rules as the operator’s booking page: their hours, breaks, days off, existing bookings and the same-day notice. Each slot has start_time (HH:MM, the operator’s local time), is_after_hours, and the price that applies at that time,

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Checks that a service, date and start time are open right now, and returns a joinmane.com link to the operator’s booking page with that service, date and time filled in. It does not book, hold the time, charge or contact anyone: the booking is made only when the client opens the link and confirms it
